subject: website
name: ASGARDEX
summary: A THORChain and MAYAChain wallet and exchange. Its code is open source and every script it runs ships in its own bundle, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: balances, quotes and vault addresses come from centralised APIs that are not checked against any chain.

operations.name: Create or unlock the keystore wallet
operations.note: The seed is generated and encrypted on this computer, and no other party takes part.

operations.name: Send BTC, ETH and other native assets
operations.note: Signed on this computer and settled by each chain. Balances, unspent outputs and fee rates come from centralised APIs, which can mislead or refuse but cannot redirect the funds.

operations.name: Swap through THORChain or MAYAChain
operations.note: The code does what it promises, but the vault address and the quote are read from a centralised API, so a lying endpoint could send funds astray. Node operators can also halt trading by vote.

operations.name: Add or withdraw liquidity
operations.note: The same exposure as a swap: vault addresses and pool data come from a centralised API.

connections.name: THORChain and MAYAChain APIs (Midgard, THORNode, MAYANode)
connections.note: Public endpoints run by a few operators. Answers are not proven against either chain.

connections.name: Blockchain data providers (Blockcypher, Haskoin, Etherscan, Blockfrost)
connections.note: Balances and history from centralised indexers, unchecked. Each learns the addresses you hold.

connections.name: EVM JSON-RPC endpoints (publicnode, 1rpc, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Avalanche)
connections.note: Read without a light client, so every answer is trusted as given.

connections.name: Price data (CoinGecko)
connections.note: One centralised source. It changes displayed values only.
